title: Acme Manufacturing Executive Opportunity Package
goal: Research Acme Manufacturing, prepare an executive opportunity brief, draft a personalized outreach package, route it through compliance, request human approval, and generate the final deliverable.

agents.name: Market Intelligence
agents.responsibility: Assess opportunity fit and operational priorities

agents.name: Communications Agent
agents.responsibility: Draft executive outreach using the approved style guide

agents.name: Compliance Reviewer
agents.responsibility: Check claims, sources, tone, and required approvals

stages.title: Goal intake
stages.output: Normalized goal, constraints, and success criteria

stages.title: Opportunity qualification
stages.output: Fit assessment, priorities, risks, and recommended approach

stages.title: Personalized outreach draft
stages.output: Email draft addressed to Priya Shah

stages.title: Compliance review
checks: Every material claim has a source
No unsupported savings or certification claims
No real customer or personal data

stages.title: Human approval
stages.output: Recorded approval decision and reviewer note

stages.title: Final package delivery
stages.output: Executive brief, outreach draft, compliance record, next actions, and audit summary

success_criteria: The workflow visibly pauses at the approval gate
At least four source identifiers appear in the final brief
The final package is available only after approval
The audit summary records goal, stages, agents, sources, and decision
